sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate correctly targets iceStringer, supplies all declared operands and results, enforces the canonical datatypes and units, applies the max(p*h, 0.15) branch, uses MN/m for the Z and A formulas, and explicitly converts the line-load result to kN/m. The derived results are checked with expected-result-scaled tolerances, and the prior unit-conversion instruction is satisfied.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the formula mixes units. The canonical designLineLoad property is constrained to qudt:unit KiloN-PER-M, but the calculation stores max(p_MPa*h_m, 0.15), whose numeric result is in MN/m, and then uses that unconverted value in the Z and A formulas. Convert the line-load result to kN/m when validating designLineLoad (multiply the MN/m result by 1000), while use the MN/m value for the section-modulus and shear-area formula operands, or otherwise make the unit conversions explicit and consistent.

The candidate correctly targets iceStringer, supplies all declared operands and results, enforces the canonical datatypes and units, applies the max(p*h, 0.15) branch, uses MN/m for the Z and A formulas, and explicitly converts the line-load result to kN/m. The derived results are checked with expected-result-scaled tolerances, and the prior unit-conversion instruction is satisfied.
